newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola juice unit to serve Shoney's chain. [CORRECTED 18:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola juice unit to serve Shoney's chain. [CORRECTED 18:55 GMT]

text.p: Coca-Cola Co said it has signed a five-year agreement to make its Minute Maid Foodservice unit the exclusive juice supplier at Shoney's Inc's chain of 554 company-owned restaurants. (Corrects to make clear that they are not pizza restaurants)
Minute Maid will also be the preferred juice supplier in Shoney's 307 franchises, Coca-Cola said.
Conversion to Minute Maid should be completed this autumn, the company said, replacing Seagram Co Ltd's Tropicana brand of orange juices in the restaurants.
